flows: Full Access Admin view of CrowdStrike contribution to risk score

User mapping status (Matched / Unmatched CrowdStrike identity / No CrowdStrike data)
open_questions_flagged: Does Dune need a generalized external risk signal ingestion framework, or is this a CrowdStrike-specific build?
What is Dune's security posture for storing customer-provided CrowdStrike API credentials?
What is the exact scoring/escalation math for the No Endpoint Visibility weight?
Should real-time streaming (vs. scheduled polling) be in scope for v1?
confidence_notes: No Figma exists yet. Feature intent, weighting model, and licensing-gating behavior are well-grounded in CrowdStrike API research. Product decisions on score blending (single blended score), missing-coverage treatment (No Endpoint Visibility as a distinct non-neutral signal), and mapping (via existing IAM identity) were confirmed directly with the stakeholder during PRD research. Exact UI layout (settings page structure, breakdown view placement) and the precise No Endpoint Visibility scoring formula still need design-strategist input, Eng estimation, and eventual Figma validation.
